definitions.explanation: The collective term for cereal grains such as rice, wheat, barley, and corn. Used in food, agriculture, and nutrition contexts.

examples.japanese: {穀類|こくるい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{主食|しゅしょく}→主食：11408_shushoku⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Grains are important as a staple food.

examples.japanese: {穀類|こくるい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上昇|じょうしょう}している→上昇する：21681_joushousuru⟧。

⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{精製|せいせい}→精製：21559_seisei⟧⟦されていない→する：00392_suru⟧{穀類|こくるい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: For my health, I try to eat more unrefined grains.

notes:
A general term encompassing cereal grains — ⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧ (rice), ⟦{麦|むぎ}→麦：05427_mugi⟧ (wheat/barley), {玉蜀黍|とうもろこし} (corn), {粟|あわ} (millet), etc. Commonly used in nutrition labels, agricultural reports, and food science. In everyday conversation, specific grain names are more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {穀類|こくるい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ — to eat grains
- {全粒|ぜんりゅう}{穀類|こくるい} — whole grains
- {穀類|こくるい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生産|せいさん}→生産：01444_seisan⟧ — grain production
- {穀類|こくるい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧ — grain prices

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{穀物|こくもつ}→穀物：02806_kokumotsu⟧ — grain, cereal; very similar meaning, slightly more common in general contexts
- ⟦{雑穀|ざっこく}→雑穀：20948_zakkoku⟧ — miscellaneous grains (millet, sorghum, etc.); grains other than rice and wheat
- ⟦{主食|しゅしょく}→主食：11408_shushoku⟧ — staple food; broader category that includes grains but also potatoes, bread, etc.
